title: Jimmy Carter: Outsider
credits: Kelly Jean Kelly wrote this story for Learning English. George Grow was the editor.

sentences.en: VOA Learning English presents America’s Presidents.
sentences.zh: 美国之音英语学习节目为您带来“美国总统”系列。

sentences.en: Today we are talking about Jimmy Carter.
sentences.zh: 今天我们聊聊吉米·卡特。

sentences.en: His given name was James, but he liked to be called Jimmy.
sentences.zh: 他的教名是詹姆斯，但他喜欢被人叫作吉米。

sentences.en: Carter was elected president in 1976.
sentences.zh: 卡特于1976年当选总统。

sentences.en: Until he campaigned for the office, few Americans knew who he was.
sentences.zh: 在他竞选这一职位之前，很少有美国人知道他是谁。

sentences.en: But Carter said his lack of experience with the federal government made him the best candidate.
sentences.zh: 但卡特说，他对联邦政府缺乏经验，恰恰使他成为最佳人选。

sentences.en: After witnessing years of problems in the White House, many voters appeared to agree with him.
sentences.zh: 在目睹了白宫多年的种种问题后，许多选民似乎都认同他的观点。

sentences.en: However, Carter’s inexperience also became a problem.
sentences.zh: 然而，卡特缺乏经验也成了一个麻烦。

sentences.en: Some of the issues he faced were complex and, at times, they seemed overwhelming.
sentences.zh: 他所面临的一些问题十分复杂，有时甚至显得难以应付。

sentences.en: After only one term, Carter failed to get re-elected.
sentences.zh: 仅仅任期一届，卡特就未能连任。

sentences.en: But in time, his public image improved.
sentences.zh: 但随着时间的推移，他的公众形象有所改善。

sentences.en: His years after leaving the White House are generally considered more successful than his time in office.
sentences.zh: 他卸任后白宫之外的岁月，通常被认为比在任时更为成功。

sentences.en: Jimmy Carter was born in the southern state of Georgia.
sentences.zh: 吉米·卡特出生于南部的佐治亚州。

sentences.en: He was the oldest of four children.
sentences.zh: 他是四个孩子中最年长的一个。

sentences.en: His father was a businessman.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲是一名商人。

sentences.en: His mother was a nurse.
sentences.zh: 他的母亲是一名护士。

sentences.en: The family owned a store, as well as a peanut farm and warehouse.
sentences.zh: 这家人经营着一家商店，还拥有一处花生农场和仓库。

sentences.en: Although the businesses did well, Jimmy Carter grew up very modestly.
sentences.zh: 尽管生意做得不错，吉米·卡特却过着非常简朴的生活。

sentences.en: His family’s house did not have electricity or running water.
sentences.zh: 全家的住宅既没有电，也没有自来水。

sentences.en: But he was hardworking and wanted to be successful.
sentences.zh: 但他勤奋努力，渴望取得成功。

sentences.en: As a boy, he saved enough money to buy four houses.
sentences.zh: 小时候，他攒够了钱买了四栋房子。

sentences.en: He earned more money by renting them to other people.
sentences.zh: 他把这些房子租给别人，赚到了更多的钱。

sentences.en: He also decided to attend college at the United States Naval Academy.
sentences.zh: 他还决定就读美国海军学院。

sentences.en: And in time, he did so.
sentences.zh: 后来，他果然如愿以偿。

sentences.en: Carter was an excellent student.
sentences.zh: 卡特是一名品学兼优的学生。

sentences.en: And he became a fine Naval officer.
sentences.zh: 他成为了一名出色的海军军官。

sentences.en: As a midshipman, Carter worked on one of the country’s first nuclear submarines.
sentences.zh: 作为一名海军学员，卡特曾在一艘该国最早建造核潜艇上工作。

sentences.en: He later taught nuclear engineering to other crewmembers.
sentences.zh: 他后来向其他船员讲授核工程知识。

sentences.en: But Carter’s promising career in the Navy ended after only seven years.
sentences.zh: 但卡特在海军前途无量的职业生涯仅仅持续了七年便结束了。

sentences.en: His father was dying.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲病危。

sentences.en: And the family farm was in trouble.
sentences.zh: 家里的农场也陷入了困境。

sentences.en: Carter, his wife, Rosalynn, and their three sons, decided to return to Georgia and try to save it.
sentences.zh: 卡特、他的妻子罗莎琳以及他们的三个儿子决定回到佐治亚州，设法挽救农场。

sentences.en: The first years back on the farm were difficult.
sentences.zh: 回到农场的头几年十分艰难。

sentences.en: But in time, the business became successful again.
sentences.zh: 但随着时间的推移，这项生意又重新走上了正轨。

sentences.en: Carter began to turn his attention to other issues.
sentences.zh: 卡特开始把注意力转向其他问题。

sentences.en: He became involved in his church, local school, hospitals and libraries.
sentences.zh: 他积极参与教堂、当地学校、医院和图书馆的活动。

sentences.en: When he had a chance to compete for a position in the state senate, he took it.
sentences.zh: 当他有机会竞选州参议员职位时，他抓住了这个机会。

sentences.en: As a politician, Carter developed an image as an independent thinker who tried to save the government money.
sentences.zh: 作为一名政治家，卡特树立了独立思考、努力为国家节省经费的形象。

sentences.en: He also acted and spoke strongly against racial discrimination.
sentences.zh: 他还强烈地行动并发声反对种族歧视。

sentences.en: In Georgia at the time, many voters did not agree with Carter’s support of racial equality.
sentences.zh: 当时的佐治亚州，许多选民并不认同卡特对种族平等的支持。

sentences.en: In 1966, even his own Democratic Party did not choose him to be its candidate to represent Georgia in the U.S. Senate.
sentences.zh: 1966年，就连他自己的民主党都没有推选他作为代表佐治亚州出任美国参议员的候选人。

sentences.en: So Carter began campaigning for the office of state governor instead.
sentences.zh: 于是，卡特转而竞选州长职务。

sentences.en: In 1970, he was elected.
sentences.zh: 1970年，他当选了。

sentences.en: As Georgia's governor, Carter was known as a social and political reformer.
sentences.zh: 作为佐治亚州州长，卡特以社会和政治改革者而闻名。

sentences.en: However, historian Robert Strong notes that Carter did not always work well with others in his party.
sentences.zh: 然而，历史学家罗伯特·斯特朗指出，卡特并不总是能与党内的其他人良好合作。

sentences.en: Strong teaches at Washington and Lee University in Lexington, Virginia.
sentences.zh: 斯特朗在弗吉尼亚州列克星敦的华盛顿与李大学任教。

sentences.en: He writes that some Georgia lawmakers believed Carter was “arrogant.”
sentences.zh: 他写道，一些佐治亚州的立法者认为卡特“傲慢”。

sentences.en: He could appear to think he was morally right, and they were morally wrong.
sentences.zh: 他似乎认为自己道德上正确，而他们道德上错误。

sentences.en: Carter’s difficulty in getting along with other officials proved to be one of the problems he would later face.
sentences.zh: 卡特在与同僚相处上的困难，后来被证明是他所面临问题之一。

sentences.en: But in the presidential election of 1976, many Americans seemed to like this quality.
sentences.zh: 但在1976年的总统大选中，许多美国人似乎很喜欢这一品质。

sentences.en: The little-known governor from Georgia defeated the sitting president, Gerald Ford.
sentences.zh: 这位默默无闻的佐治亚州州长击败了时任总统杰拉尔德·福特。

sentences.en: Carter won, in part, by saying that he was different than other politicians.
sentences.zh: 卡特获胜，部分原因在于他声称自己与其他政治家不同。

sentences.en: He was, he said, a Washington outsider.
sentences.zh: 他说，他是华盛顿的局外人。

sentences.en: Then suddenly, Carter was the biggest insider of all: the American president.
sentences.zh: 然而突然间，卡特成了最大的局内人：美国总统。

sentences.en: One of the things Carter wanted to do was change the image of the president.
sentences.zh: 卡特想做的其中一件事就是改变总统的形象。

sentences.en: Earlier leaders, such as Richard Nixon and Lyndon Johnson, had increased the power of the presidency.
sentences.zh: 早期的领导人，如理查德·尼克松和林登·约翰逊，扩大了总统的权力。

sentences.en: Nixon had also been shown to be dishonest, and resigned from office.
sentences.zh: 尼克松也被揭露不诚实，并辞去了职务。

sentences.en: Carter promised never to lie to the American people.
sentences.zh: 卡特承诺绝不向美国人民撒谎。

sentences.en: And on the day of his swearing-in as president, he purposefully tried to keep things simple.
sentences.zh: 在他就任总统的那一天，他有意力求保持简单。

sentences.en: He walked to the White House from the U.S. Capitol building instead of riding in the back of an automobile.
sentences.zh: 他步行从国会大厦走到白宫，而不是坐进轿车的后座。

sentences.en: His wife, Rosalynn, wore clothes that she had worn in public before.
sentences.zh: 他的妻子罗莎琳穿着她以前在公共场合穿过衣服。

sentences.en: The National First Ladies’ Library notes that her choice of clothing sent a message of "an old American value of thrift – or respecting money, and not spending it needlessly.”
sentences.zh: 美国第一夫人图书馆指出，她的着装选择传达了一种“美国传统节俭价值观——即尊重金钱，不浪费花钱。”

sentences.en: What she wore was meaningful because the country was going through difficult economic times.
sentences.zh: 她所穿的服装具有重要意义，因为国家正经历艰难的经济时期。

sentences.en: The Carters wanted to show that the new government would work to cut costs.
sentences.zh: 卡特夫妇希望表明新政府将努力削减开支。

sentences.en: They also wanted to show that they were there to help the American people, not enjoy the powers of the White House.
sentences.zh: 他们还想表明自己是来帮助美国人民的，而不是来享受白宫权力的。

sentences.en: But in the end, the Carter administration received poor ratings in surveys of public opinion.
sentences.zh: 但最终，卡特的政府在民意调查中获得了较低的评价。

sentences.en: President Carter had trouble dealing with U.S. lawmakers, even when his party was in control of Congress.
sentences.zh: 卡特总统在与美国立法者打交道时遇到困难，即使他的政党控制着国会。

sentences.en: One result was that Carter could not advance many of his ideas for legislation.
sentences.zh: 其结果之一是卡特无法推进他的许多立法主张。

sentences.en: He appeared ineffective.
sentences.zh: 他显得无所作为。

sentences.en: Many historians point out that, in fact, Carter had a number of successes.
sentences.zh: 许多历史学家指出，事实上，卡特取得了一系列成功。

sentences.en: He helped reduce the country’s dependence on foreign oil.
sentences.zh: 他帮助减少了国家对进口石油的依赖。

sentences.en: He took steps to make the federal government more efficient, and to improve the environment.
sentences.zh: 他采取措施使联邦政府更加高效，并改善环境。

sentences.en: He appointed a number of women and racial minorities to top government jobs -- an important move at a time when many were pressing for women’s rights and civil rights.
sentences.zh: 他任命了一批女性和少数族裔担任政府要职——在许多人呼吁妇女权利和民权的当时，这是一项重要举措。

sentences.en: And, in many cases, Carter supported human rights causes, both in the United States and around the world.
sentences.zh: 而且，在许多情况下，卡特支持人权事业，无论是在美国还是在世界各地。

sentences.en: But the public generally did not see Carter for his successes.
sentences.zh: 但公众通常没有看到卡特的成功之处。

sentences.en: Instead, many Americans blamed him for the country’s economic problems.
sentences.zh: 相反，许多美国人把国家的经济问题归咎于他。

sentences.en: Some also disliked the way he spoke to them.
sentences.zh: 有些人也不喜欢他说话的方式。

sentences.en: In one speech, Carter blamed the country’s troubles on what he called a crisis of confidence.
sentences.zh: 在一次演讲中，卡特把国家的困境归因于他所谓的“信任危机”。

sentences.en: Some listeners were offended.
sentences.zh: 一些听众感到被冒犯了。

sentences.en: He also decided that the U.S. would not attend the 1980 Olympic Games in Moscow.
sentences.zh: 他还决定美国将不参加在莫斯科举行的1980年奥运会。

sentences.en: The move was meant to punish the Soviet Union for its involvement in Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 此举旨在惩罚苏联对阿富汗的介入。

sentences.en: But many Americans believed the move mostly hurt young American Olympians.
sentences.zh: 但许多美国人认为，这一举措主要伤害了年轻的美国奥运选手。

sentences.en: The administration also faced other problems.
sentences.zh: 政府还面临其他问题。

sentences.en: The president was never accused of wrongdoing.
sentences.zh: 总统从未被指控有任何不当行为。

sentences.en: But other high-level officials were.
sentences.zh: 但其他高层官员却被指控了。

sentences.en: So was the president’s brother, Billy.
sentences.zh: 总统的弟弟比利也是如此。

sentences.en: As a result, Jimmy Carter’s public image for honesty suffered.
sentences.zh: 因此，吉米·卡特的诚实公众形象受损。

sentences.en: Then came the Iran hostage crisis.
sentences.zh: 随后发生了人质危机。

sentences.en: The conflict between the United States and Iran had a long history.
sentences.zh: 美国与伊朗之间的冲突有着悠久的历史。

sentences.en: One part involved the Shah of Iran.
sentences.zh: 其中一部分涉及伊朗国王。

sentences.en: The U.S. government had supported his rise to power, partly because American interests wanted to control Iran’s oil.
sentences.zh: 美国政府曾支持他登上王位，部分原因是美国利益希望控制伊朗的石油。

sentences.en: But the Shah severely abused his power.
sentences.zh: 但这位国王严重滥用职权。

sentences.en: Many Iranians resisted.
sentences.zh: 许多伊朗人进行了抵抗。

sentences.en: Some wanted a leader who would more closely obey Islamic teachings.
sentences.zh: 有些人希望有一位更严格遵守伊斯兰教义的领导人。

sentences.en: In 1979, under pressure from those Iranians and others, the Shah fled the country.
sentences.zh: 1979年，在那些伊朗人及其他人的压力下，国王逃离了该国。

sentences.en: By now, he was suffering from cancer.
sentences.zh: 到那时，他正患着癌症。

sentences.en: So, as a humanitarian act, President Carter permitted the Shah to come to the United States for medical treatment.
sentences.zh: 因此，作为一项人道主义行动，卡特总统允许国王来到美国接受治疗。

sentences.en: The move made many Iranians angry.
sentences.zh: 这一举措让许多伊朗人感到愤怒。

sentences.en: In protest, a group of students seized the U.S. embassy in Tehran, the capital of Iran.
sentences.zh: 为了抗议，一群学生占领了位于伊朗首都德黑兰的美国使馆。

sentences.en: They took 90 people, including 66 Americans, hostage.
sentences.zh: 他们劫持了90人，其中包括66名美国人。

sentences.en: Carter worked hard to get the hostages released.
sentences.zh: 卡特努力争取人质获释。

sentences.en: He tried diplomatic negotiations and economic restrictions.
sentences.zh: 他尝试了外交谈判和经济制裁手段。

sentences.en: But his efforts did not work.
sentences.zh: 但他的努力没有奏效。

sentences.en: Finally, he tried a secret military operation.
sentences.zh: 最后，他尝试了一次秘密军事行动。

sentences.en: He sent eight helicopters and a team of special forces to enter the embassy and rescue the hostages.
sentences.zh: 他派出八架直升机和一支特种部队进入使馆营救人质。

sentences.en: But that operation failed, too.
sentences.zh: 但那次行动也失败了。

sentences.en: The weather was bad.
sentences.zh: 天气状况恶劣。

sentences.en: Three of the helicopters crashed.
sentences.zh: 三架直升机坠毁。

sentences.en: Eight Americans were killed.
sentences.zh: 八名美国人遇难。

sentences.en: And the public’s approval of Jimmy Carter dropped even more.
sentences.zh: 公众对吉米·卡特的支持率进一步下降。

sentences.en: After 444 days, the remaining hostages were released.
sentences.zh: 经过444天，剩余的人质终于获释。

sentences.en: In exchange, the U.S. government agreed to end some of its economic sanctions against Iran and promised not to interfere in the country’s affairs.
sentences.zh: 作为交换，美国政府同意结束部分对伊朗的经济制裁，并承诺不干涉该国内政。

sentences.en: None of the hostages had been seriously hurt.
sentences.zh: 人质中没有严重受伤者。

sentences.en: But the crisis was the final blow to Carter’s presidency.
sentences.zh: 但这场危机成为卡特总统生涯的致命一击。

sentences.en: A few months before they were released, his effort to seek re-election failed.
sentences.zh: 在人质获释前几个月，他争取连任的努力失败了。

sentences.en: As president, Carter did not meet the high expectations he had set for himself.
sentences.zh: 作为总统，卡特没有达到他为自己设定的高期望。

sentences.en: And he faced some unusually difficult situations.
sentences.zh: 他还面临一些非同寻常的困难局面。

sentences.en: His presidency also suffered from his problems communicating effectively with Congress, the media, and the American people.
sentences.zh: 他的总统任期还因与国会、媒体和美国民众沟通不畅而受损。

sentences.en: But his four years as president did leave several marks on the office.
sentences.zh: 但他的四年总统生涯确实给这一职位留下了若干印记。

sentences.en: For one, he showed that the U.S. president could help other nations and sides resolve their disputes.
sentences.zh: 其中之一，是他表明美国总统能够帮助其他国家及各方解决争端。

sentences.en: Carter’s best-known success as president was his help negotiating the Camp David Accords.
sentences.zh: 卡特作为总统最著名的成就是他在戴维营协议谈判中发挥的作用。

sentences.en: The accords were a peace agreement between Egypt and Israel.
sentences.zh: 这项协议是埃及和以色列之间的一项和平协议。

sentences.en: Carter led the talks at Camp David in Maryland.
sentences.zh: 卡特在马里兰州的戴维营主持了这些谈判。

sentences.en: Carter’s efforts to protect human rights overseas also influenced the foreign policy of later presidents.
sentences.zh: 卡特在海外保护人权的努力也影响了后来几位总统的外交政策。

sentences.en: In time, his work as a defender of human rights has become his most important legacy.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移,他作为人权捍卫者的工作已成为他最重要的遗产。

sentences.en: Several years after leaving the presidency, he founded the Carter Presidential Center at Emory University in Atlanta, Georgia.
sentences.zh: 在卸任总统数年后,他在佐治亚州亚特兰大的埃默里大学创建了卡特总统中心。

sentences.en: The center “seeks to prevent and resolve conflicts, enhance freedom and democracy, and improve health.”
sentences.zh: 该中心"致力于预防和解决冲突,促进自由与民主,改善健康状况"。

sentences.en: In addition to his work there, Carter has helped build houses for people who need them, written books, and negotiated with world leaders to take steps toward peace.
sentences.zh: 除了在那里的工作外,卡特还帮助为有需要的人建造房屋,撰写书籍,并与世界领导人进行谈判,以采取迈向和平的步骤。

sentences.en: In 2002, Carter received the Nobel Peace Prize for his efforts.
sentences.zh: 2002年,卡特因其努力而获得诺贝尔和平奖。

sentences.en: I’m Kelly Jean Kelly.
sentences.zh: 我是凯莉·简·凯利。

glossary.def: something that is so confusing or difficult that you feel unable to do it
a person who is trained to care for sick or injured people
to allow someone to use (something) in return for payment
a feeling or belief that someone or something is good or has the ability to succeed at something
